record.original_question: For 0 < beta < 1, define the one-dimensional discrete centered fractional maximal operator by M_beta f(n) = sup_{r>=0} (2r+1)^{beta-1} sum_{k=-r}^r |f(n+k)|, where the supremum is over nonnegative integers r, and let q = 1/(1-beta). If f : Z -> R has bounded variation and M_beta f is not identically infinite, is there a universal constant C such that the q-variation of M_beta f satisfies Var_q(M_beta f) <= C Var(f)?

evidence.quote: For 0 ≤ β < 1 and f : Z → R, we define the one-dimensional discrete centered fractional maximal operator by Mβ f (n) = sup_{r≥0} 1/(2r + 1)^{1−β} ∑_{k=−r}^r |f(n + k)|.

Question 10. Let 0 < β < 1 and q = 1/(1 − β). Let f : Z → R be a function of bounded variation such that Mβ f is not identically infinite. Do we have Var q (Mβ f) ≤ C Var (f) for some universal constant C?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Fix a parameter $0<\beta<1$ and set $q=1/(1-\beta)$. For a function $f:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathbb{R}$, define the one-dimensional discrete centered fractional maximal operator by
$$M_\beta f(n)\;=\;\sup_{r\in\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}}\;\frac{1}{(2r+1)^{1-\beta}}\sum_{k=-r}^{r}|f(n+k)|,\qquad n\in\mathbb{Z}.$$
For a function $g:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathbb{R}$ and $1\le p<\infty$, define its $p$-variation by
$$\operatorname{Var}_p(g)\;=\;\Big(\sum_{n\in\mathbb{Z}}|g(n+1)-g(n)|^{p}\Big)^{1/p},$$
and write $\operatorname{Var}(g)=\operatorname{Var}_1(g)$ for the (total) variation.

Question: Does there exist a universal constant $C=C(\beta)>0$ (independent of $f$) such that, for every $f:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathbb{R}$ of bounded variation for which $M_\beta f$ is not identically $+\infty$,
$$\operatorname{Var}_q(M_\beta f)\;\le\;C\,\operatorname{Var}(f)?$$
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in the discrete fractional maximal operator regularity literature. While related results exist for one-sided/uncentered discrete fractional maximal operators (with $\ell^1\to\mathrm{BV}$-type bounds), no resolution of this $\operatorname{Var}_q$ inequality for the centered discrete fractional maximal operator was located in the search. Status appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Endpoint regularity of discrete multisublinear fractional maximal operators
status_evidence.snippet: Endpoint regularity results for discrete fractional maximal operators on l^1 balls.
status_evidence.claim: Related endpoint regularity is known in nearby settings, but the centered q-variation question remains the standing open problem.

status_evidence.claim: Active researcher on regularity of discrete maximal operators; no announcement of a resolution of this Var_q bound for centered discrete fractional maximal operator was found.
status_evidence.snippet: Research focused on fine properties of maximal functions.
